title: Rich Creme Hair Colour Natural Black 1.00

details.description: Godrej Expert Rich Creme is an ammonia-free creme hair colour enriched with aloe vera. Multi-application kit with colourant, developer and brush-friendly mixing for 100% grey coverage, long-lasting colour and ultra-soft, deep shine.
details.dangerWarnings: Hair colourants can cause severe allergic reactions. Read and follow instructions. This product is not intended for use on persons under the age of 16. Caution: This product contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation in certain rare cases. Hence, the Skin Hypersensitivity Test should be performed according to the accompanying directions 48 hours before each application of this product. Use only as directed. Do not use for any purpose other than for which this product is intended. Avoid contact of the product with the skin and eyes. Warning: This product should not be used for colouring the eyelashes or eyebrows, as its use may cause blindness. Rinse eyes immediately if product comes in contact with them. Consult a physician if irritation persists. Do not use hair colour if your scalp is sore, has any cuts or abrasions or is in a diseased condition. Skin Hypersensitivity Test: Always perform the test 48 hours before each and every application. Cleanse a small area of skin behind the ear or the inner surface of the forearm using soap and water or alcohol, apply a small quantity of the product on the previously cleansed skin and allow it to dry. Wash after 48 hours with soap and water and observe. The colour can be considered safe for use if no reddening, burning, itching, irritation or swelling is experienced in or around the test area. Safety instructions: Follow the instruction leaflet inside the pack. Temporary 'black henna' tattoos may increase your risk of allergy. Do not colour your hair if you have a rash on your face or sensitive, irritated and damaged scalp, if you have ever experienced any reaction after colouring your hair, or if you have experienced a reaction to a temporary 'black henna' tattoo in the past. Wear suitable gloves during application. Rinse hair well after application. Keep out of the reach of children. It is only for use on cranial (head) hair. Do not inhale or ingest. Store/protect from direct sunlight and heat. Poison: Not for internal use.
details.ingredients: Colourant (Type 3): Aqua (Water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Ethanolamine, Ceteareth-20, p-Phenylenediamine, Paraffinum Liquidum, Resorcinol, Polyquaternium-37, Phenyl Methyl Pyrazolone, N,N-Bis(2-Hydroxyethyl)-p-Phenylenediamine Sulphate, 2,4-Diaminophenoxyethanol HCl, m-Aminophenol, Ascorbic Acid, Aloe Vera Extract, Milk Protein, Sodium Sulphite, PPG-1 Trideceth-6, Parfum (Perfume), CI 11680, CI 74260. Developer: Aqua (Water), Hydrogen Peroxide, Cetyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG-100 Stearate, Tetrasodium Pyrophosphate, Disodium EDTA, Phosphoric Acid, Sodium Lauryl Sulphate, Sodium Stannate.
details.usageInstructions: Wear gloves and mix an equal quantity of colourant and developer (1:1) in a plastic or glass bowl. Apply the mixture evenly on washed and completely dried hair with a brush. Leave on for 30 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with water. Perform the Skin Hypersensitivity Test 48 hours before each and every application.
